Method of Attack: Uncompiled portable executable file to avoid detection by gateway and endpoint security solutions
Runs C# compiler via command line to activate payload
Malicious agent generates XML SOAP requests every 2 minutes to check-in and receive commands from command and control server
Impacted Systems: Windows Defender detects and blocks on endpoint
Attack Vector: Hosting malicious files on Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure
Command and control communication via SOAP requests to systemservicex.azurewebsites.net
